description.text: Students from more than69different countries are pursuing forbachelor's degree programs, master'sdegreeprograms,doctoral degreeprograms and Chinese language programsin Yangtze University now,includingUSA, Canada, France, Spain, Korea, Mexico, Bolivia, Mongolia, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Ukraine, Indonesia, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, Myanmar, Malaysia Pakistan, Nepal, Jordan, Chile, Papua New Guinea, Uganda, Zambia, Ghana, Cameroon, Tanzania, Namibia, Angola, Rwanda, Comoros, Benin, Niger, Zimbabwe, Morocco, Gabon, Kenya, Sudan, Benin, Liberia, Chad and son on.Students from all over the world are welcome to study in Yangtze University.Students from all over the world are welcome to study in Yangtze University

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Yangtze University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Yangtze University Application Form 2.Official transcript of higher learning institution 3.Official graduation certificate 4.Photocopy of passport 5.Physical Examination Record for Foreigners

requirements.text: Applicants who apply for bachelor degree should be below 25 years old. Applicants must take Physical Examination after arrival. If applicants' result of Physical Examination is not fit for the residence permit, applicants must leave the university.
